contracts.printedText:

Whenever you play a {R} card, put a Violence counter on Atavic Fury.

As long as there are 10 or more Violence counters on Atavic Fury, whenever you win a confrontation, you gain 10 points.

contracts.name: Sandokaron, Banners Bearer
contracts.printedText:
Sandokaron enters the field with 1 Banner Counter.
As long as Sandokaron is on the field, when you win a confrontation put 1 Banner Counter on it. If instead you lose a confrontation, remove 1 Banner Counter.
As long as Sandokaron is on the field, you may remove 1 Banner Counter and choose one:
  •  A target manifestation on the field gets +3 power;
  •  Gain 2 🔥 essences.
If at the end of the turn there are no Banner Counters on Sandokaron, Exile it.
contracts.printedParagraph: •  A target manifestation on the field gets +3 power;

contracts.name: Powerful Pidue
contracts.printedText:
As long as Powerful Pidue is on the field, when an opponent plays a Manifestation in Support or a Will from their hand during the Confrontation Phase:
If 🔥, a target Manifestation on the field gets -1 power until the end of the turn.
If ⚡, a target Manifestation on the field loses its current effects until the end of the turn.
If 🌿, put a Token with 1 🌿 power in Support under your control.
If 💧, draw 1 card.
If 🔮, a target player Discards 1 card from their hand.
contracts.printedParagraph: If 🔥, a target Manifestation on the field gets -1 power until the end of the turn.
